resources.string: We, RAN, are a start up fuelled with the intention to solve the practical problems around us. We observed that in our busy and bustling colleges that are brimming with technological advances, students have a hard time finding co-riders to share rides with if they are to travel by a rented car. This problem is a consequence of the apparently remote locations of our college which does not facilitate an availability of a quality car renting service. Moreover, a student\'s choice of mode of transport would depend a great deal on their finding co-riders so that their expenses can be cut. Well, we have a wonderful solution!
